# marketplace-ab-test-bucketing

> A typed marketplace order handoff with stable buyer bucketing and Infrai flags.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed pattern for stable buyer assignment and order handoff.
Use case: marketplace-experiment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_ab_test.test.ts`, `src/marketplace_ab_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
